title: NEWS 10 ABC: ‘WishMakers Wanted’ to spread joy, hope to critically ill children
body_markdown:
The celebration was part of World Wish Month.


'World Wish Month highlights what makes wishes possible: the WishMakers who give, fundraise, and lend their voice to the mission,” Jesse Tomczak, EVP and Chief Banking Officer at Pioneer and Board Chair of Make-A-Wish Vermont & Northeast New York, said. “I’ve seen firsthand the impact those efforts can have, and I’m proud that Pioneer is among those helping make wishes become reality for children and families.'"


[Read the full story covered by Courtney Ward from NEWS 10 here.](https://www.news10.com/community/wishmakers-wanted-to-spread-joy-hope-to-critically-ill-children/)
